dimensions.assessment: Affects state wildlife agencies and programs receiving funds under the North American Wetlands Conservation Act.
dimensions.evidence: interest earned on revenue generated from excise taxes on certain firearms, ammunition, and archery equipment must be used for wildlife conservation and restoration programs

dimensions.assessment: Continues an existing funding mechanism without creating a new program or altering primary tax structures.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3(b)(2)(C) of the Pittman-Robertson Wildlife Restoration Act... is amended by striking ``2026'' and inserting ``2033''.

dimensions.assessment: Directs the allocation of interest generated from obligations held in the restoration fund through 2033 rather than altering total federal revenue or tax rates.
dimensions.evidence: interest on obligations held in the Federal aid to wildlife restoration fund shall become available for apportionment at the beginning of fiscal year 2033.

dimensions.assessment: Extends a single expiration date within an existing conservation financing statute.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3(b)(2)(C) of the Pittman-Robertson Wildlife Restoration Act... is amended by striking ``2026'' and inserting ``2033''.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the provision for a duration of seven fiscal years (from FY2026 through FY2032).
dimensions.evidence: extends until FY2033 a requirement for the interest earned on certain funds held in the Federal Aid to Wildlife Restoration Fund

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts of interest projected to accrue in the fund through FY2033.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends an existing funding distribution rule for interest earned on the Federal Aid to Wildlife Restoration Fund from FY2026 until FY2033, keeping funds dedicated to specific conservation programs rather than general apportionment.
